position_sizing.conditional_logic: Starts at minLot per symbol. When position profit > Lot[i]*k_change, Lot[i] increments by minLot and an additional minLot position is opened in same direction. On reversal (loss > Lot[i]*k_change), Lot[i] resets to minLot and Type[i] flips. On global close, Lot[i] resets to minLot.

custom_logic_notes: Multi-currency grid/martingale EA trading 10 currency pairs simultaneously. Core logic: 1) Opens initial position per symbol at minLot based on Type[i] direction (BUY if true, SELL if false). 2) If existing position profit > Lot[i]*k_change, increments Lot[i] by minLot and opens another minLot position in same direction (grid scale-in). 3) If existing position loss > Lot[i]*k_change, flips Type[i] direction and closes the position (martingale reversal - next entry will be opposite direction). 4) If minLot position profit > minLot*k_closse, closes position (small profit target). 5) Global circuit breaker: if total floating loss > 'loss' or total floating profit > 'profit', ALL 10 positions are closed and all lots reset. 6) No SL/TP set on individual orders (0,0 passed to PositionOpen). 7) Free margin must exceed 'margin' parameter to open new positions. 8) The Lot[i] array tracks cumulative lot size per symbol for threshold calculations but actual additional orders are always minLot size. All thresholds (k_change, k_closse, loss, profit) are in account currency units, not pips.
python_conversion_notes: This EA is fundamentally tick-driven with no bar-based logic, requiring tick data for accurate backtesting. The multi-symbol simultaneous management (10 pairs with shared global equity checks) demands a portfolio-level backtesting framework. Key challenges: 1) Position-dependent lot tracking (Lot[i] array) persists across reversals - must maintain per-symbol state. 2) Global equity circuit breaker checks across all 10 symbols require aggregate portfolio P/L monitoring every tick. 3) The PositionSelect/PositionGetDouble MT5 API assumes one position per symbol (hedging=false, netting account assumed) - Python implementation must enforce this. 4) k_change, k_closse, loss, profit are in deposit currency not pips - conversion depends on symbol tick value. 5) Trade.mqh provides CTrade class for order execution - Python needs equivalent market order submission with proper error handling. 6) No SL/TP means risk is entirely managed by the global circuit breaker and individual reversal logic, which depends on tick-by-tick monitoring. 7) The martingale lot increment and direction flip logic is stateful and must be carefully preserved across trade cycles.
